content:
After reading wasm benchmarks at https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/113488-general/topic/DOM.20Manipulation.20in.20Lean/with/625220505, I've got some ideas to improve the bigint bottlenecks.

  • Use GMP function for base conversion (currently Nat.repr depends on Nat.toDigits which is quadratic and painfully slow at that); mpn_get_str supports bases from 2 to 256
  • Same applies to String.Slice.toNat? (though it was not tested in the benchmarks), which can use mpn_set_str or mpz_set_str
  • Implement basic subquadratic mul/div algorithms for no-GMP builds in C++, or alternatively if leanprover/lean4#14050 lands, implementation in Lean might also work. Whether such Lean code fits in lean4 repo is another question though (bootstrapping issue?)
